Name: Mara Vellum - The Archive Restorer
Author: AleksSmash2020
Description:
Mara Vellum is a new non-romance museum NPC for Stardew Valley. Her purpose is simple: make repeat mineral finds feel like part of an archive rather than dead inventory, while keeping the exchange limited enough that the museum economy still matters.

[b]The archive loop[/b]

Meet Mara inside the museum archive and bring the specified specimen bundles. The first release uses Quartz, Earth Crystals and Frozen Tears as the main surplus materials. Eligible bundles are exchanged for Archive Seals. Seals then feed a separate, friendship-gated Archive Exchange with modest geode rewards. This is a deliberate two-step loop—specimen surplus becomes archive credit, and archive credit becomes a limited utility reward—not a general-purpose shop or an unlimited mineral converter.

[b]Friendship progression[/b]

Mara has an original portrait, overworld sprite, museum schedule, gift tastes and 60+ lines of English/Russian dialogue. Events at 2, 5 and 8 hearts reveal the provenance story behind the archive and progressively open the museum-side exchange. Reward tiers include a Geode, a Frozen Geode after the archive opens and one limited Omni Geode after the provenance event.

[b]Installation and compatibility[/b]

Install SMAPI and Content Patcher, then place `Mara Vellum - The Archive Restorer` in the Stardew Valley `Mods` folder. The pack adds a namespaced NPC, object, shop and museum interaction property. It does not replace vanilla NPC assets, add a new season or food pack, or repeat a beach salvage, river survey or dialogue-only loop.

[b]Credits and disclosure[/b]

This release contains original content and original visual assets created with AI assistance. AI-Generated Content is tagged honestly on the page.
